ruleDefinitions.name: DllUnregisterServer Function Call Via Msiexec.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects MsiExec loading a DLL and calling its DllUnregisterServer function

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "\\msiexec\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-z\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*"))
